chunks: And those who are doomed, will be in Hell: For them will be sighing and sobbing,
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Zafir and Shahiq in Surah Hud?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological torment of the 'Ashyaq' (the doomed), where 'zafir' and 'shahiq' signify the audible expressions of regret and despair that accompany their eternal punishment. This state reflects the culmination of their worldly arrogance and rejection of divine guidance, serving as a stark contrast to the tranquility promised to the 'Sa'da' (the fortunate). The imagery underscores the permanence of their suffering, emphasizing that their misery is both physical and spiritual.
